title: Delivered contexts carry provenance and an upstream-first position; a project holding one reads its own, first
situation: Cratylic context design is delivered beside the workflow and is upstream of it, so a fresh session reads it and the readings show it first. Decision 0301 gave a delivered context its origin, release version and identity, and nothing that orders several; ordering by file name only happened to put the upstream one first.
decision: A delivered context carries its origin, its release's version, its identity (the identity of the context's earliest entry carrying one, else that entry's id) and its position, its 0-based place in upstream-first order within its origin; the release delivers cratylic context design at 0 and workflow at 1, each at every install scope whatever rulesets are chosen. Every reading orders delivered contexts by origin, then position, never by file name. A project whose journal holds an entry with a delivered context's identity reads the context as its own, part of its design, and the delivered copy is not shown apart; among the project's own contexts, those whose identity is a delivered context's come first in delivered order, then the rest in record order. A delivered document without a position is refused, naming the remedy: install again with the cratylus in use.
consequences: Supersedes 0301. Cratylus's own repository reads cratylic context design, then workflow, from its journal; every other project reads both as delivered, read-only, in that order. An installation projected by an earlier cratylus must be installed again before its journal readings work. Closing the books still writes openings in record order.
